name: KY-051 voltage translator (level shifter)
not_buildable: It is not a sensor: it converts signals between two voltage levels, and LearnLens does not plan wiring with it yet.
identification: Small black PCB with a 14-pin chip in the middle and two rows of 6 upright pins along the long edges.

facts.statement: Four-channel level shifter between a lower voltage side (Vcca, A1 to A4) and a higher one (Vccb, B1 to B4). Vccb must be greater than or equal to Vcca.
